metaDescription: Order custom 3/4 sleeve jackets for your team. Ideal for layering and mild weather. Get a quote from Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Custom 3/4 sleeve jackets offer a versatile layering option that bridges the gap between a full-zip jacket and a vest. The shorter sleeve length provides freedom of movement and breathability, making them ideal for outdoor events, team uniforms, or promotional giveaways during spring and fall. Choose from fleece, quilted, or hybrid styles with your logo embroidered or screen printed.
heroAltText: Custom 3/4 sleeve jackets with embroidered logo on a hybrid fleece style for corporate branding
